categories.AgentGroup: Agent-group aggregates over the BU's agents — 'Agent Group - *'
categories.Agent: Per-agent metrics for Agent Grid widgets — 'Agent - *'

duplicatePairs.reason: not a duplicate — structurally broken Calc; nearest working equivalent

metrics.originalDescription: Agent - Number of Active Chats
metrics.shortDescription: Number of chats the agent is handling right now.
metrics.longDescription: Real-time count of chat interactions currently open at the agent (chat concurrency).
metrics.comparison: Completed counterpart: MonAgentNumChatsCompleted.

metrics.originalDescription: Agent - Number of Answered Chats
metrics.shortDescription: Number of incoming chats the agent answered and finished today.
metrics.longDescription: Counts incoming chats answered by the agent that have already ended.
metrics.comparison: Live counterpart: MonAgentNumChatsActive.

metrics.originalDescription: Agent - Number of Answered Incoming Calls
metrics.shortDescription: Number of incoming calls/callbacks the agent answered and finished today.
metrics.longDescription: Counts incoming calls and callbacks answered by the agent that are already completed (talk ended). NOTE: the MetricId mentions "MakeCalls" for historical reasons — the metric actually counts INCOMING answered interactions.
metrics.comparison: In-progress interactions are excluded until they end.

metrics.originalDescription: Agent - Number of Consultation Calls
metrics.shortDescription: Number of consultation calls the agent made today.
metrics.longDescription: Cumulative count of times the agent entered the "Consulting Call" state — consulting a colleague/expert during interaction handling.
metrics.comparison: Frequent consults may indicate knowledge gaps or complex traffic.

metrics.originalDescription: Agent - Number of Incoming Calls with Talk Time more than 10 minutes
metrics.shortDescription: Number of incoming calls the agent handled with talk time over 10 minutes today.
metrics.longDescription: Counts incoming external calls/callbacks whose talk time exceeded 600 seconds. Highlights unusually long conversations for coaching or complexity analysis.
metrics.comparison: Opposite profile: MonAgentNumberOfInboundCalls15sec.

metrics.originalDescription: Agent - Number of Incoming Calls with Talk Time less than 15 seconds
metrics.shortDescription: Number of incoming calls the agent handled with talk time under 15 seconds today.
metrics.longDescription: Counts incoming external calls/callbacks whose talk time was below 15 seconds. A spike usually means premature disconnects or "call dumping" and is a standard quality red flag.
metrics.comparison: Opposite profile: MonAgentNumberOfInboundCalls10Min (very long calls).

metrics.originalDescription: Agent - Number of Incoming External Calls
metrics.shortDescription: Intended: incoming external calls only. Actual: identical to the External+Internal metric (filter bug).
metrics.longDescription: The description promises external calls only, but the stored filter also admits intercom calls, making this row an exact duplicate of MonAgentNumberOfInboundCallsWithIntercom. Recommended fix: remove CallType=="Intercom" from the filter so the metric matches its name.
metrics.comparison: Until fixed, both metrics return the same value.
metrics.notes: Exact duplicate of MonAgentNumberOfInboundCallsWithIntercom; fix filter (drop Intercom) or delete.

metrics.originalDescription: Agent - Number of Incoming External and Internal Calls
metrics.shortDescription: Number of incoming calls and callbacks the agent received today, external and internal.
metrics.longDescription: Counts incoming voice interactions (calls and callbacks) handled by the agent today, including both external and intercom (internal) calls.
metrics.comparison: MonAgentNumberOfInboundCallsOnly currently has an IDENTICAL filter (duplicate) although its name promises external-only — see duplicate analysis.

metrics.originalDescription: Agent - Number of Outbound Calls
metrics.shortDescription: Number of outgoing external calls the agent made today.
metrics.longDescription: Counts outgoing external voice calls initiated by the agent today.
metrics.comparison: Group counterpart: MonSumAgentsMakeCalls. Average duration: MonAgentAverageMakeCallDuration.

metrics.originalDescription: Agent - Number of Outgoing Callbacks
metrics.shortDescription: Number of callback return-calls the agent completed today.
metrics.longDescription: Counts outgoing callback interactions (dial-backs to customers) made by the agent and answered today.
metrics.comparison: Incoming side: MonAgentProxyCallsNum.

metrics.originalDescription: Agent - Number of Incoming Callbacks
metrics.shortDescription: Number of incoming callback interactions the agent answered today.
metrics.longDescription: Counts incoming callback interactions answered by the agent today (excluding the original callback requests themselves).
metrics.comparison: Outgoing side: MonAgentOutgoingCallbacksNum.

metrics.originalDescription: Agent - Calls per Hour
metrics.shortDescription: Incoming calls handled by the agent per hour.
metrics.longDescription: Agent-level throughput: incoming calls handled normalised per hour of work, computed by the engine CPH function.
metrics.comparison: Queue counterpart: QueueCPH.

metrics.originalDescription: Agent - Number of Internal Calls
metrics.shortDescription: Number of internal (intercom) calls involving the agent today.
metrics.longDescription: Counts intercom interactions of the agent today, any direction. Internal communication load.

metrics.originalDescription: Agent - Number of Missed Calls
metrics.shortDescription: Number of times the agent missed a routed interaction today.
metrics.longDescription: Cumulative count of times today the agent entered the "Missed Call" state — an interaction was routed to the agent and not answered. Discipline/availability indicator.
metrics.comparison: Group real-time counterpart: MonSumAgentsInMissedCall.

metrics.originalDescription: Agent - Messages Avg First Response Time
metrics.shortDescription: Average time to the agent’s first reply in messaging conversations today.
metrics.longDescription: Agent-level FRT: average time from conversation arrival to the agent’s first reply.
metrics.comparison: Queue counterpart: MessagesAvgFirstResponseTime.

metrics.originalDescription: Agent - Messages Avg Response Time
metrics.shortDescription: Average reply time of the agent to customer messages today.
metrics.longDescription: Agent-level average time between a customer message and the agent’s reply (all replies).
metrics.comparison: Queue counterpart: MessagesAvgResponseTime.

metrics.originalDescription: Agent - Available State Duration
metrics.shortDescription: Total time the agent spent in AVAILABLE-group states today.
metrics.longDescription: Cumulative time today in statuses of the AVAILABLE group — idle-ready time waiting for interactions.
metrics.comparison: Percent of login: MonAgentAvailableDurationPct.

metrics.originalDescription: Agent - Average Dialer Calls Duration
metrics.shortDescription: Average duration of the agent’s dialer (campaign) calls today.
metrics.longDescription: Average time per stay in the "Campaign Call" status today.
metrics.comparison: Dialer volume: MonAgentNumberOfInboundCallsDialer.

metrics.originalDescription: Agent - Average Handling Duration
metrics.shortDescription: Average duration of one ONPHONE engagement of the agent today.
metrics.longDescription: Average time per stay in ONPHONE-group statuses today — a practical per-interaction handling-time proxy at agent level.
metrics.comparison: Components: talk (MonAgentTalkDuration), hold (MonAgentHeldDuration), wrap-up (MonAgentWrapUpDuration).

metrics.originalDescription: Agent - Average Call Duration
metrics.shortDescription: Average talk duration of incoming calls/callbacks completed by the agent today.
metrics.longDescription: Average talk time of the agent’s completed incoming external calls and callbacks (interaction-based, excludes in-progress).
metrics.comparison: Status-based handling average: MonAgentAverageCallDuration.

metrics.originalDescription: Agent - Average Oubound Call Duration
metrics.shortDescription: Average duration of the agent’s outbound calls today.
metrics.longDescription: Average time per stay in the "Out Ext Call" status today.
metrics.comparison: Outbound count: MonAgentNumberOfMakeCalls.

metrics.originalDescription: Agent - Cumulative Break Group Duration
metrics.shortDescription: Total time the agent spent in BREAK-group states today.
metrics.longDescription: Cumulative time today in break-type statuses (lunch, short break, etc.).
metrics.comparison: Percent of login: MonAgentBreakDurationPct. Single-state alternative: see specific states.

metrics.originalDescription: Agent - Current Login Duration
metrics.shortDescription: Time since the agent’s current login.
metrics.longDescription: Duration of the agent’s current login session, ticking in real time.
metrics.comparison: Cumulative counterpart: MonAgentLoginTime (all sessions today).

metrics.originalDescription: Agent - Cumulative  Incoming Ext Call Duration
metrics.shortDescription: Total time the agent spent on incoming external calls today.
metrics.longDescription: Cumulative time today in the "Incoming Ext Call" status — incoming-talk subset of total talk time.
metrics.comparison: Total talk (all interaction types): MonAgentTalkDuration.

metrics.originalDescription: Agent - Current Incoming Ext Call Duration
metrics.shortDescription: Duration of the incoming external call the agent is handling right now.
metrics.longDescription: Real-time duration of the agent’s current "Incoming Ext Call" status; zero/empty when not on an incoming external call.
metrics.comparison: Group max: MonSumAgentsLongestCurrentCall.

metrics.originalDescription: Agent - Cumulative Hold Duration
metrics.shortDescription: Total time the agent kept customers on hold today.
metrics.longDescription: Cumulative time today in the "Hold" status. Hold time is an AHT component and a customer-experience irritant.
metrics.comparison: AHT = talk + hold + wrap-up; see MonAgentTalkDuration and MonAgentWrapUpDuration.

metrics.originalDescription: Agent - Cumulative Login Duration
metrics.shortDescription: Total logged-in time of the agent today (all sessions).
metrics.longDescription: Sum of all the agent’s login sessions today. Denominator for all "percent of login time" metrics.
metrics.comparison: Current session only: MonAgentCurrentLoginDuration.

metrics.originalDescription: Agent - Max Call Duration
metrics.shortDescription: Longest talk time of a single incoming call of the agent today.
metrics.longDescription: Maximum talk duration among the agent’s incoming external calls/callbacks today.
metrics.comparison: Real-time current call: MonAgentDurationOfCurrentCall.

metrics.originalDescription: Agent - Cumulative Paperwork Group Duration
metrics.shortDescription: Total time the agent spent in PAPERWORK-group states today.
metrics.longDescription: Cumulative time today in after-call-work / back-office statuses (PAPERWORK group).
metrics.comparison: Percent of login: MonAgentPaperworkDurationPct. Single Wrap Up state: MonAgentWrapUpDuration.

metrics.originalDescription: Agent - Current Status Group Duration
metrics.shortDescription: How long the agent has been in the current status GROUP.
metrics.longDescription: Real-time duration of the agent’s stay in the current status group: switching between states inside one group (e.g. Lunch to Coffee Break) does not reset this timer.
metrics.comparison: State-level timer: MonAgentStateDuration.

metrics.originalDescription: Agent - Current Status Duration
metrics.shortDescription: How long the agent has been in the current status.
metrics.longDescription: Real-time duration of the agent’s current status, whatever it is. Universal wallboard timer column.
metrics.comparison: Group-level duration of current status group: MonAgentStateDescDuration.

metrics.originalDescription: Agent - Cumulative Talk Duration
metrics.shortDescription: Total time the agent spent in ONPHONE-group states today.
metrics.longDescription: Sum of all time today in statuses of the ONPHONE group — total customer-facing talk time.
metrics.comparison: Percent of login: MonAgentTalkDurationPct. Per-call average: MonAgentAverageCallDuration.

metrics.originalDescription: Agent - Active Interaction State Duration
metrics.shortDescription: How long the agent’s longest active interaction has been in its current state.
metrics.longDescription: Real-time duration of the current state (e.g. talking, hold) of the agent’s longest active interaction.
metrics.comparison: Interaction state itself: MonAgentTelState.

metrics.originalDescription: Agent - Cumulative Unavailable State Duration
metrics.shortDescription: Total time the agent spent in the "Unavailable" state today.
metrics.longDescription: Cumulative time today in the specific "Unavailable" status.

metrics.originalDescription: Agent - Cumulative Wrap Up Duration
metrics.shortDescription: Total time the agent spent in the "Wrap Up" state today.
metrics.longDescription: Cumulative time today in the specific "Wrap Up" status (one state of the PAPERWORK group).
metrics.comparison: Group-wide ACW: MonAgentPaperworkDuration.

metrics.originalDescription: Agent - Login Name
metrics.shortDescription: Display/login name of the agent.
metrics.longDescription: Static attribute used as the row label in Agent Grid widgets.

metrics.originalDescription: Agent - Active Interaction Queue Name
metrics.shortDescription: Queue (workgroup) name of the agent’s longest active interaction.
metrics.longDescription: Real-time attribute: which queue the longest active interaction came from.

metrics.originalDescription: Agent - Active Interction ID
metrics.shortDescription: Identifier of the agent’s longest active interaction.
metrics.longDescription: Real-time attribute: the interaction ID of the agent’s longest currently-active interaction.
metrics.comparison: Companions: type, state, queue, customer number of the same interaction.

metrics.originalDescription: Agent - Current Login Time Stamp
metrics.shortDescription: Timestamp of the agent’s current login.
metrics.longDescription: Attribute: start time of the current login session.
metrics.notes: RESOLVED 2026-06-07: MetricFunction corrected to CurLoginTimestamp (matches engine UserManager.cs).

metrics.originalDescription: Agent - Extension ID
metrics.shortDescription: Telephony extension of the agent.
metrics.longDescription: Static attribute: the agent’s extension number.

metrics.originalDescription: Agent - First Login Time Stamp
metrics.shortDescription: Timestamp of the agent’s first login today.
metrics.longDescription: Static-per-day attribute: when the agent first logged in today.
metrics.comparison: Current session start: MonAgentCurrentLoginTimeStamp.

metrics.originalDescription: Agent - Current Satatus
metrics.shortDescription: Name of the agent’s current status.
metrics.longDescription: Real-time text attribute: the title of the agent’s current Agent State (e.g. Available, Lunch, Wrap Up).
metrics.comparison: Group name: MonAgentStateDesc. Timer: MonAgentStateDuration.

metrics.originalDescription: Agent - Current Status Group
metrics.shortDescription: Status group of the agent’s current status.
metrics.longDescription: Real-time text attribute: the status group (AVAILABLE / ONPHONE / BREAK / PAPERWORK / TRAINING) of the agent’s current state.
metrics.comparison: State name: MonAgentState.

metrics.originalDescription: Agent - Station ID
metrics.shortDescription: Workstation/phone station identifier of the agent.
metrics.longDescription: Static attribute: the station the agent is logged into.

metrics.originalDescription: Agent - Active Interaction State
metrics.shortDescription: State of the agent’s longest active interaction.
metrics.longDescription: Real-time attribute: current state (e.g. talking, hold) of the longest active interaction.
metrics.comparison: Duration of that state: MonAgentTelStateDuration.

metrics.originalDescription: Change -ID of a representative who was connected that day
metrics.shortDescription: Flag/ID indicating the agent logged in today.
metrics.longDescription: Technical attribute marking agents who connected during the current day. NOTE: its Description in the DB ("Change -ID of a representative...") lacks the standard "Agent -" prefix and needs normalisation.
metrics.notes: Description lacks category prefix; normalise to "Agent - ..." form.

metrics.originalDescription: Agent - User ID
metrics.shortDescription: Platform user identifier of the agent.
metrics.longDescription: Static attribute: the agent’s user ID on the CC platform.

metrics.originalDescription: Agent - Active Interaction Type
metrics.shortDescription: Type (Call/Chat/...) of the agent’s longest active interaction.
metrics.longDescription: Real-time attribute: interaction type of the longest active interaction.

metrics.originalDescription: Agent - Active Interaction Customer Phone Number
metrics.shortDescription: Customer phone number of the agent’s longest active interaction.
metrics.longDescription: Real-time attribute: remote-party number of the longest active interaction. PII — apply masking policies where required.
metrics.notes: PII field; consider masking in widgets.

metrics.originalDescription: Agent - Cumulative Available Duration Percent
metrics.shortDescription: Share of the agent’s login time spent in AVAILABLE states today.
metrics.longDescription: Cumulative AVAILABLE-group time divided by total login time — the idle-ready share.
metrics.comparison: High % Available + low % Talk = under-utilisation; the inverse suggests overload.

metrics.originalDescription: Agent - Cumulative Break Duration Percent
metrics.shortDescription: Share of the agent’s login time spent in BREAK states today.
metrics.longDescription: Cumulative BREAK-group time divided by total login time — per-agent break shrinkage.
metrics.comparison: Group counterpart: MonSumAgentsBreakDurationPercent.

metrics.originalDescription: Agent - Cumulative Paperwork Duration Percent
metrics.shortDescription: Share of the agent’s login time spent in PAPERWORK states today.
metrics.longDescription: Cumulative PAPERWORK-group time divided by total login time — ACW share.
metrics.comparison: Group counterpart: MonSumAgentsPaperworkDurationPercent.

metrics.originalDescription: Agent - Cumlative Talk Duration Percent
metrics.shortDescription: Share of the agent’s login time spent in ONPHONE states today.
metrics.longDescription: Cumulative ONPHONE-group time divided by total login time. Practical per-agent occupancy proxy (talk-based; excludes wrap-up).
metrics.comparison: Companions: % Available, % Break, % Paperwork, % Training.

metrics.originalDescription: Agent - Cumulative Training Duration Percent
metrics.shortDescription: Share of the agent’s login time spent in TRAINING states today.
metrics.longDescription: Cumulative TRAINING-group time divided by total login time.

metrics.originalDescription: Agent Group - Max duration of  Break State Group
metrics.shortDescription: Longest time any agent of the group has currently been in a Break-group state.
metrics.longDescription: Real-time maximum: among agents currently in a BREAK-group state, the duration of the longest ongoing break. Highlights overstayed breaks on wallboards.
metrics.comparison: Percent counterpart: MonSumAgentsBreakDurationPercent.

metrics.originalDescription: Agent Group - Percent of Agents in Break State Group
metrics.shortDescription: Share of the group’s logged-in time spent in Break-group states.
metrics.longDescription: Cumulative percentage for today: total time agents of the Business Unit spent in BREAK-group states divided by their total logged-in time. Core shrinkage indicator.
metrics.comparison: Per-agent counterpart: MonAgentBreakDurationPct.

metrics.originalDescription: Agent Group - Percent of Agents in Paperwork State Group
metrics.shortDescription: Share of the group’s logged-in time spent in Paperwork-group states.
metrics.longDescription: Cumulative percentage for today: total PAPERWORK-group time divided by total logged-in time of the group. Measures ACW/back-office load.
metrics.comparison: Per-agent counterpart: MonAgentPaperworkDurationPct.

metrics.originalDescription: Agent Group - Number of Dialer Calls
metrics.shortDescription: Number of incoming dialer (campaign) interactions today.
metrics.longDescription: Counts dialer-type interactions (outbound-campaign calls delivered to agents as incoming) registered today, external or intercom. NOTE: description prefix says "Agent Group" while DataType is "User"; the engine resolves the non-"UsersInteraction" DataType to the queue interaction set, so this behaves as a queue-scope counter.
metrics.comparison: Average duration counterpart: MonAgentAverageAgentDialerDuration.

metrics.originalDescription: Agent Group - Number of Answered Incoming Calls and Callbacks
metrics.shortDescription: Number of incoming calls and callbacks answered and completed by agents of this group today.
metrics.longDescription: Counts incoming external calls and callbacks that agents of the Business Unit answered and have already finished (talk ended, no longer in queue). Computed over the agent-group interaction set (UsersInteraction).
metrics.comparison: Queue-side near-equivalent: QueueNumAnsweredCallsAndCallbacks (counts on answer, includes in-progress).

metrics.originalDescription: Agent Group - Average Talk Duration in Incoming Calls and Callbacks
metrics.shortDescription: Average talk duration of incoming calls and callbacks completed by this group today.
metrics.longDescription: Average conversation time of incoming external calls and callbacks finished today by agents of the Business Unit, computed over the agent-group interaction set.
metrics.comparison: Queue-side counterpart: QueueAvgTalkingDurationCallsAndCallbacks.

metrics.originalDescription: Agent Group - Average Talk Duration in Incoming Chats
metrics.shortDescription: Average handling duration of incoming chats completed by this group today.
metrics.longDescription: Average chat-handling time of incoming chats finished today by agents of the Business Unit (agent-group interaction set).
metrics.comparison: Queue-side counterpart: QueueAvgTalkingDurationChats.

metrics.originalDescription: Agent Group - Current Max Talk Duration
metrics.shortDescription: Duration of the longest interaction currently being handled by an agent of this group.
metrics.longDescription: Real-time maximum talk duration among interactions currently in progress within the Business Unit. Flags conversations running unusually long.
metrics.comparison: Per-agent counterpart: MonAgentDurationOfCurrentCall.

metrics.originalDescription: Agent Group - Number of Otbound Calls
metrics.shortDescription: Number of outgoing external interactions made by agents of this group today.
metrics.longDescription: Counts outgoing external interactions initiated by agents of the Business Unit today (computed over the agent-group interaction set).
metrics.comparison: Queue-side counterpart: QueueNumOutboundCalls. Per-agent: MonAgentNumberOfMakeCalls.

metrics.originalDescription: Agent Group - Number of Agents on Missed Call
metrics.shortDescription: Number of agents currently in the "Missed Call" state.
metrics.longDescription: Real-time count of agents whose current state is "Missed Call" — the state an agent enters after failing to answer a routed interaction. Persistent non-zero values signal routing or discipline issues.
metrics.comparison: Per-agent cumulative counterpart: UserNumMissedCalls.

metrics.originalDescription: Agent Group - Number of Agents in Available State
metrics.shortDescription: Number of agents currently in the specific "Available" Agent State.
metrics.longDescription: Real-time count of agents whose current Agent State is exactly "Available". Counts the raw platform state, not the status group: custom states mapped to the AVAILABLE group (e.g. "Ready-Chat") are NOT included.
metrics.comparison: Group-level counterpart: QueueLoginDataNumAvailableUsers.

metrics.originalDescription: Agent Group - Number of Agents in Break State
metrics.shortDescription: Number of agents currently in the specific "Break" Agent State.
metrics.longDescription: Real-time count of agents whose current Agent State is exactly "Break". States like "Lunch" or "Coffee Break" are not included even though they belong to the BREAK group.
metrics.comparison: Group-level counterpart: QueueLoginDataNumBreakUsers.

metrics.originalDescription: Agent Group - Number of Agents in On Phone State
metrics.shortDescription: Number of agents currently in the specific "On Phone" Agent State.
metrics.longDescription: Real-time count of agents whose current Agent State is exactly "On Phone" (raw state, not the ONPHONE group).
metrics.comparison: Group-level counterpart: UsersSumOnCall.

metrics.originalDescription: Agent Group - Number of Agents in Paperwork State
metrics.shortDescription: Number of agents currently in the specific "Paperwork" Agent State.
metrics.longDescription: Real-time count of agents whose current Agent State is exactly "Paperwork" (raw state, not the PAPERWORK group).
metrics.comparison: Group-level counterpart: QueueLoginDataNumPaperworkUsers.

metrics.originalDescription: Agent Group - Number of Agents in Training State
metrics.shortDescription: Number of agents currently in the specific "Training" Agent State.
metrics.longDescription: Real-time count of agents whose current Agent State is exactly "Training" (raw state, not the TRAINING group).
metrics.comparison: Group-level counterpart: QueueLoginDataNumTrainingUsers.

metrics.originalDescription: Agent Group - Number of Available Agents
metrics.shortDescription: Number of agents currently in the AVAILABLE status group.
metrics.longDescription: Real-time count of agents of the Business Unit whose current status belongs to the AVAILABLE status group (ready to take an interaction).
metrics.comparison: StateCountAvailable counts the specific "Available" Agent State only; this metric counts the whole group.

metrics.originalDescription: Agent Group - Number of Agents in Break State Group
metrics.shortDescription: Number of agents currently in any Break-group state.
metrics.longDescription: Real-time count of agents whose current status belongs to the BREAK status group (lunch, short break, coffee break etc.).
metrics.comparison: StateCountBreak counts only the specific "Break" state; this metric covers all break-type states.

metrics.originalDescription: Agent Group - Number of Curently Logged in Users
metrics.shortDescription: Number of agents of the Business Unit currently logged in.
metrics.longDescription: Real-time count of agents currently signed into the platform within this Business Unit, in any status. Baseline for staffing and occupancy assessment.
metrics.comparison: QueueNumberOfLoggedAgents is its (deprecated) duplicate. Available/Break/Paperwork counts are subsets.

metrics.originalDescription: Agent Group - Number of Agents in Paperwork State Group
metrics.shortDescription: Number of agents currently in any Paperwork-group state (ACW/back-office).
metrics.longDescription: Real-time count of agents whose current status belongs to the PAPERWORK status group (after-call work, administrative tasks).
metrics.comparison: QueueNumWrapUpAgents counts the single "Wrap Up" state only.

metrics.originalDescription: Agent Group - Number of Agents in Training State Group
metrics.shortDescription: Number of agents currently in any Training-group state.
metrics.longDescription: Real-time count of agents whose current status belongs to the TRAINING status group. NOTE: this row carries an anomalous DataType ("String" instead of "UsersSummary") and empty default columns — harmless to the engine (DataType is ignored for status counters) but should be normalised.
metrics.comparison: StateCountTraining counts the specific "Training" state only.

metrics.originalDescription: Agent Group - Number of On Call Agents
metrics.shortDescription: Number of agents currently in the ONPHONE status group (handling an interaction).
metrics.longDescription: Real-time count of agents whose current status belongs to the ONPHONE group — actively handling customer interactions.
metrics.comparison: QueueNumOnCallAgents is its (deprecated) duplicate. StateCountOnPhone counts the specific state only.

metrics.originalDescription: QM - Average Time to Aband of Callbacks in Queue
metrics.shortDescription: Average time callback interactions (customer-requested return calls handled by the queue) waited in queue before being abandoned today.
metrics.longDescription: Average queue time of abandoned callback interactions (customer-requested return calls handled by the queue): how long customers were prepared to wait before giving up. Useful for setting realistic Service Level targets — if customers abandon at 40 seconds, a 60-second target is too slow.
metrics.comparison: Subset of 'Average Wait Time' restricted to abandoned interactions.

metrics.originalDescription: QM - Average Time to Aband of Calls in Queue
metrics.shortDescription: Average time external incoming voice calls waited in queue before being abandoned today.
metrics.longDescription: Average queue time of abandoned external incoming voice calls: how long customers were prepared to wait before giving up. Useful for setting realistic Service Level targets — if customers abandon at 40 seconds, a 60-second target is too slow.
metrics.comparison: Subset of 'Average Wait Time' restricted to abandoned interactions.

metrics.originalDescription: QM - Average Time to Aband of Calls and Callbacks in Queue
metrics.displayName: Average Time to Abandon — Calls + Callbacks
metrics.shortDescription: Average time combined voice load: external incoming calls and callbacks waited in queue before being abandoned today.
metrics.longDescription: Average queue time of abandoned combined voice load: external incoming calls and callbacks: how long customers were prepared to wait before giving up. Useful for setting realistic Service Level targets — if customers abandon at 40 seconds, a 60-second target is too slow.
metrics.comparison: Subset of 'Average Wait Time' restricted to abandoned interactions.

metrics.originalDescription: QM - Average Time to Aband of Chats in Queue
metrics.shortDescription: Average time incoming chat interactions waited in queue before being abandoned today.
metrics.longDescription: Average queue time of abandoned incoming chat interactions: how long customers were prepared to wait before giving up. Useful for setting realistic Service Level targets — if customers abandon at 40 seconds, a 60-second target is too slow.
metrics.comparison: Subset of 'Average Wait Time' restricted to abandoned interactions.

metrics.originalDescription: QM - Average Time to Aband of Interactions in Queue
metrics.displayName: Average Time to Abandon — Digital Interactions
metrics.shortDescription: Average time non-voice digital interactions (chat and e-mail) waited in queue before being abandoned today.
metrics.longDescription: Average queue time of abandoned non-voice digital interactions (chat and e-mail): how long customers were prepared to wait before giving up. Useful for setting realistic Service Level targets — if customers abandon at 40 seconds, a 60-second target is too slow.
metrics.comparison: Subset of 'Average Wait Time' restricted to abandoned interactions.

metrics.originalDescription: QM - Messages Avg First Response Time
metrics.shortDescription: Average time to the first agent reply in messaging channels today.
metrics.longDescription: Average time between message arrival and the first agent response. The key responsiveness KPI (FRT) for chat/messaging channels.
metrics.comparison: MessagesAvgResponseTime covers ALL replies, not only the first one.

metrics.originalDescription: QM - Messages Avg Response Time
metrics.shortDescription: Average agent response time to customer messages today (all replies).
metrics.longDescription: Average time between any customer message and the following agent reply. Measures sustained conversation responsiveness, not only the first touch.
metrics.comparison: MessagesAvgFirstResponseTime isolates the first reply.

metrics.originalDescription: QM - Messages Max First Response Time
metrics.shortDescription: Longest first-response time to an incoming message today.
metrics.longDescription: The maximum time customers waited today for the FIRST agent reply in messaging channels. Worst-case indicator of digital responsiveness.
metrics.comparison: Average counterpart: MessagesAvgFirstResponseTime.

metrics.originalDescription: QM - Percent of Abandoned Callbacks
metrics.shortDescription: Share of incoming callback interactions (customer-requested return calls handled by the queue) abandoned in queue, out of all that finished queuing today.
metrics.longDescription: Abandoned callback interactions (customer-requested return calls handled by the queue) divided by incoming completed callback interactions (customer-requested return calls handled by the queue). The standard Abandonment Rate KPI: a direct measure of customers lost in the queue. Callback requests are not counted as abandoned.
metrics.comparison: Complementary to '% Answered'.

metrics.originalDescription: QM - Percent of Abandoned Calls
metrics.shortDescription: Share of incoming external incoming voice calls abandoned in queue, out of all that finished queuing today.
metrics.longDescription: Abandoned external incoming voice calls divided by incoming completed external incoming voice calls. The standard Abandonment Rate KPI: a direct measure of customers lost in the queue. Callback requests are not counted as abandoned.
metrics.comparison: Complementary to '% Answered'.

metrics.originalDescription: QM - Percent of Abandoned Calls and Callbacks
metrics.shortDescription: Share of incoming combined voice load: external incoming calls and callbacks abandoned in queue, out of all that finished queuing today.
metrics.longDescription: Abandoned combined voice load: external incoming calls and callbacks divided by incoming completed combined voice load: external incoming calls and callbacks. The standard Abandonment Rate KPI: a direct measure of customers lost in the queue. Callback requests are not counted as abandoned.
metrics.comparison: Complementary to '% Answered'.

metrics.originalDescription: QM - Percent of Abandoned Chats
metrics.shortDescription: Share of incoming incoming chat interactions abandoned in queue, out of all that finished queuing today.
metrics.longDescription: Abandoned incoming chat interactions divided by incoming completed incoming chat interactions. The standard Abandonment Rate KPI: a direct measure of customers lost in the queue. Callback requests are not counted as abandoned.
metrics.comparison: Complementary to '% Answered'.

metrics.originalDescription: QM - Percent of Abandoned Interactions
metrics.shortDescription: Share of incoming non-voice digital interactions (chat and e-mail) abandoned in queue, out of all that finished queuing today.
metrics.longDescription: Abandoned non-voice digital interactions (chat and e-mail) divided by incoming completed non-voice digital interactions (chat and e-mail). The standard Abandonment Rate KPI: a direct measure of customers lost in the queue. Callback requests are not counted as abandoned.
metrics.comparison: Complementary to '% Answered'.

metrics.shortDescription: Share of answered callback interactions (customer-requested return calls handled by the queue) that were picked up within 30 seconds.

metrics.originalDescription: QM - Base Answered Percent
metrics.shortDescription: Answered calls divided by ALL incoming calls today, including those still waiting.
metrics.longDescription: Unlike "% Answered Calls" (denominator = completed only), this variant divides answered calls by the full incoming volume including calls still in queue. During busy periods the value is "pessimistic": waiting calls already count against the queue.
metrics.comparison: Use % Answered Calls for end-of-day reporting; Base Answered % reacts faster intraday.

metrics.originalDescription: QM - Excluding Callback Requests Answered Percent
metrics.shortDescription: Answered calls divided by incoming calls minus callback requests.
metrics.longDescription: Removes callback requests from the denominator: customers who chose a callback are not counted against the answer rate. Shows queue performance for customers who actually stayed in the queue. Note: denominator is incoming-online (includes waiting).
metrics.comparison: Compare with Base Answered % (callback requests kept in denominator) and "Answered % incl. Callback Requests" (requests counted as success).

metrics.originalDescription: QM - Including Callback Requests Answered Percent
metrics.shortDescription: Answered calls plus callback requests, divided by all incoming calls.
metrics.longDescription: Treats a callback request as a positive outcome: numerator = answered + callback requests. The most "optimistic" answer-rate variant — useful when callback is promoted as a legitimate service path.
metrics.comparison: Compare with the Excl. variant (requests removed from both sides) and Base Answered % (requests ignored in numerator).

metrics.originalDescription: QM - Including Completed Callbacks Answered Percent
metrics.shortDescription: Answered calls plus completed callbacks, divided by all incoming calls.
metrics.longDescription: Counts a callback as success only when it was actually completed (customer reached on dial-back), unlike the "incl. Callback Requests" variant which credits the request itself.
metrics.comparison: Stricter than Incl. Callback Requests; usually between the Base and Incl-Requests values.

metrics.originalDescription: QM - Percent of Answered Calls in 60 sec Last 30 min from Incoming
metrics.displayName: % Answered Calls in 60 sec — Last 30 min
metrics.shortDescription: Service Level (60-sec target) intended to cover only the last 30 minutes.
metrics.longDescription: Intended as a rolling Service Level: share of incoming completed calls answered within 60 seconds over the last 30 minutes. WARNING: the stored formula appends the time-window condition to the Calc expression in a syntactically dubious way ("…&&InQueueDateTime>=DateTime.Now.AddHours(-0.5)"), so the time window most likely does not work as intended. Needs engine-side verification.
metrics.comparison: For a verified whole-day Service Level use "% Answered Calls in 60 sec (of incoming)".
metrics.notes: CONFIRMED broken (engine analysis 2026-06-05): unresolved identifier InQueueDateTime + double&&bool — Eval() throws every calc cycle; always empty. Deleted by migration 20260605_004; references re-pointed to QueuePctAnsweredCalls60secInc.

metrics.originalDescription: QM - Percent of Answered Calls in 30 sec from 80% Incoming
metrics.displayName: SLA: % Answered in 30 sec vs 80% Target
metrics.shortDescription: Answered-in-30-sec calls divided by 80% of incoming completed calls — progress against an 80/30 SLA.
metrics.longDescription: Variant of Service Level normalised against the 80/30 target: numerator = calls answered within 30 seconds, denominator = 0.8 x incoming completed calls. A value of 100% means the 80/30 SLA is exactly met; values above 100% mean over-performance. WARNING: the formula references "[QueueNumAnsweredCalls30sec ]" with a trailing space inside the brackets — verify the engine tolerates this.
metrics.comparison: Plain "in 30 sec (of incoming)" reports the raw percentage; this metric reports attainment vs the 80% goal.
metrics.notes: CONFIRMED (engine analysis 2026-06-05): exact-match key lookup fails on the trailing space in [QueueNumAnsweredCalls30sec ] — numerator always 0. Fixed by migration 20260605_004 (space trimmed).
